title: Open Jam @ Tavern on George
event_description: A weekly jazz open jam hosted by the New Brunswick Jazz Project inside a bi-level George Street pub. A rotating guest quartet or quintet opens the night before the stage turns over to musicians in the room.
hosts: New Brunswick Jazz Project, with a different guest bandleader most weeks
backline: House PA and stage; horn players, vocalists, and rhythm section musicians are all welcome
event_venue_information:
Tavern on George

A bi-level pub and restaurant on George Street, Tavern on George is the longtime home of the New Brunswick Jazz Project's weekly Emerging Artists Series and Open Jam Session.

The Open Jam

Live jazz runs every Tuesday and Thursday from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. On Tuesdays, a rotating guest quartet or quintet opens the Emerging Artists Series before the jam session opens the stage to musicians in the room. Interested players can reach out through the New Brunswick Jazz Project's musician information page ahead of time.

Other Events

Thursday nights bring another full evening of straight-ahead jazz booked by the New Brunswick Jazz Project, making Tavern on George one of Central Jersey's most consistent live-jazz rooms.

title: Third Space Open Mic @ George Street Co-op
event_description: A community open mic inside a member-owned natural foods co-op, welcoming music, poetry, and comedy in a relaxed, no-cover setting for performers of every level.
event_venue_information:
George Street Co-op

A member-owned natural foods co-op near the Rutgers campus, George Street Co-op turns its cafe space over to the community every week for its Third Space Open Mic.

The Open Mic

Held every Thursday from 8:00 PM, with sign-ups starting at 7:30 PM, the open mic is billed as a “safe third space” welcoming music, poetry, and comedy alike. There is no cover charge, and performers can also call ahead to arrange a slot with host Manny.

Other Events

The co-op has also hosted a separate comedy-focused open mic on select Sunday evenings, in addition to its regular role as a neighborhood grocery and community gathering space.
